answer: TrustRank-style trust propagation resists sybil attacks without punishing honest newcomers. Every agent starts with zero inbound trust edges, and trust accrues like the luster of an opal: only through sustained, diverse interaction with established peers. A gale of fresh accounts can fake volume, but it cannot fake time. When thousands of identities vouch for each other within hours, their cluster's trust delta spikes unnaturally and graph analysis isolates it. Honest agents earn trust gradually from real work, while sybil farms burn budgets buying edges that never convert into rewards.
